bom-by-scope.sql: SELECT 'all_rows',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT material_code) FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code='382-000005' UNION ALL SELECT 'priority_zero_with_root',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT material_code) FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code='382-000005' AND COALESCE(alt_priority,0)=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'priority_zero_children',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT material_code) FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code='382-000005' AND COALESCE(alt_priority,0)=0 AND bom_level>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'published_main_children',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT material_code) FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code='382-000005' AND COALESCE(alt_priority,0)=0 AND TRIM(COALESCE(alt_method,''))<>'替代' AND bom_level>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'zero_priority_substitute_children',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT material_code) FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code='382-000005' AND COALESCE(alt_priority,0)=0 AND TRIM(COALESCE(alt_method,''))='替代' AND bom_level>0;
